data.text: I’m with Kate. Luke, you’re part of the crew now—you shouldn’t have to give up your income to join us. I’ll take 10 tons this month. If we each stick to that, we can earn $10,000 apiece every month without running down the lake our families and village depend on. Let’s check the revealed catches together each month and agree on any changes before fishing. John, can you commit to 10 tons too?
